question: What will the first reported earnings per share after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Meta)

calls.reasoning: Meta guided to accrue ~$10B legal expense in Q3 2026 for the multistate youth settlement (~$3.3-3.9/sh after tax). Underlying consensus ~$6.75-6.77; Meta usually beats by 3-9%, so GAAP diluted EPS ~= $3.0-4.0, far below the 5.345 lower bound. Yahoo-style 'actual EPS' data uses GAAP (Q3'25 1.05, Q1'26 10.44), and the range is centred on Yahoo's blended $6.25-6.34 average, so GAAP resolution looks most likely (~70% belief; capped at 0.5 by the format). If resolution instead uses Meta's 'excluding the charge' figure (it gave one for Q3'25), expect ~6.9-7.4, so some mass sits above 7.345. Market check: no Polymarket/Manifold market (harness search); Kalshi has a Meta company-reports page showing '$6.39 consensus EPS', not confirmed as a traded price, so not used as an anchor.

- Q3 2026 guidance: revenue $61-64B; FY26 total expenses $165-169B; capex $130-145B; tax rate 15-17% (Meta IR Q2 release).

Admiralmarkets puts it at ~ $3.90/share after tax (=$10B/2.566B shares, i.e. treated as non-deductible); at a 16% tax rate it would be ~ $3.3/sh.
- Consensus Q3 2026 EPS: adjusted/ex-charge ~ $6.74-6.77 (TipRanks, admiralmarkets); Yahoo average $6.25 (44 analysts, low $2.88, high $7.64) mixing GAAP-inclusive and ex-charge estimates; another source cites a $7.54 average (older/stale).

- Meta beat ex-item consensus by ~8-9% in Q3'25, Q4'25, Q1'26; in Q2'26, ex legal and severance, EPS was ~7.35 vs 7.17.
- Resolution instrument: criteria blank. If it resolves off GAAP diluted EPS (Yahoo/press-release headline), expect ~3-4; if off adjusted/ex-charge EPS (Zacks / Meta's 'excluding' note), expect ~6.9-7.4. Bounds 5.345-7.345 (centred ~ Yahoo blended average).
- Event window: first EPS reported after Sep 2026 -> Q3 2026 report on Oct 28 2026; as of Oct 7 the report hasn't happened yet.
- Searched, not found: verbatim resolution criteria; whether the $10B is tax-deductible; any traded Kalshi/Polymarket EPS contract price (Kalshi page shows only a 'consensus' $6.39).
